hook: Cristobal Valenzuela is a Chilean technologist and the co-founder and CEO of Runway, a company building generative AI systems for image and video. He began exploring machine learning as a creative tool while studying at New York University's Interactive Telecommunications Program, working on early experiments that let artists and non-programmers use machine learning models. In 2018 he co-founded Runway in New York with Anastasis Germanidis and Alejandro Matamala to bring those tools to a wider audience of filmmakers and designers. Under his leadership Runway released a series of text-to-video and image generation models, including Gen-1, Gen-2, Gen-3 Alpha and Gen-4, growing from a research-driven startup into one of the most closely watched companies in generative video AI. Runway's tools have since been used in film and television production, and the company has partnered with major studios and technology firms to build custom AI models for the entertainment industry.
name: Cristobal Valenzuela

timeline.event: Worked on early machine learning creative tools as a researcher at NYU's Interactive Telecommunications Program (ITP).
timeline.impact: Laid the groundwork and initial prototypes for what became Runway.

timeline.event: Co-founded Runway in New York with Anastasis Germanidis and Alejandro Matamala.
timeline.impact: Launched what would become one of the leading generative AI video companies.

timeline.event: Runway released Gen-1 and then Gen-2, its first publicly available text-to-video and image-to-video generation models.
timeline.impact: Became one of the first companies to put broadly available AI video generation tools in front of the public.

timeline.event: Runway released Gen-3 Alpha and announced a partnership with Lionsgate to build a studio specific AI model.
timeline.impact: Signaled growing acceptance of generative AI tools within mainstream film and television production.

timeline.event: Runway released Gen-4, continuing to expand its suite of video and world simulation models.
timeline.impact: Positioned the company to compete with video models from larger AI labs entering the space.

quick_facts: Chilean-born entrepreneur based in New York City
Studied at NYU's Interactive Telecommunications Program (ITP) before founding Runway
Co-founded Runway in 2018 with Anastasis Germanidis and Alejandro Matamala
Serves as CEO of Runway, which has raised funding from investors including Google and NVIDIA
Runway's Gen-1 and Gen-2 models were among the first widely used text-to-video AI systems
Runway partnered with Lionsgate to build a custom generative video model trained on its film catalog

achievements.title: Co-founding Runway
achievements.impact: Built one of the first companies to focus specifically on generative AI for video and image creation, helping define the category of AI filmmaking tools.

achievements.title: Gen-1 and Gen-2 video models
achievements.impact: Released some of the earliest widely accessible text-to-video and video-to-video generation systems, putting AI video tools directly in the hands of creators.

achievements.title: Gen-3 Alpha and Gen-4
achievements.impact: Pushed Runway's video generation models toward higher fidelity and longer, more controllable outputs, keeping the company competitive as major AI labs entered video generation.

achievements.title: Studio partnerships
achievements.impact: Negotiated a partnership with Lionsgate to build a custom AI model trained on the studio's catalog, one of the first such deals between a major Hollywood studio and an AI company.
